when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When a yellow hard hat with a green checkmark appears above an existing house, indicating all required materials (Metal 7/1) are in storage.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Upgrading existing homes increases population density (+52 Sims) without consuming additional land or road frontage, while awarding Simoleons (+882) and XP (+11).
preconditions: Yellow hard hat with green checkmark visible on residential building
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Drag the required material directly onto the target residential building.

steps.who: yellow hard hat with green checkmark on the right residential house
steps.briefing: view the upgrade requirements for the home.
drag Metal onto the residential building to upgrade it.
